title: Your Wheel
scene: Central at morning, two lanes, wet paint. You are in the jump seat. Deac has the wheel and the thermos and the log. He will sweep the glass, hold the lane, then take one merge late on purpose so you can watch what that costs. He talks while he drives. You do not touch the wheel until he says so.
debrief: You saw the merge you do not take. He spent another man's margin to keep his. Deac hands you the wheel.
ride_along: Left mirror. Right mirror. Left again. Every time. That's the sweep. The Ledger has rooms you cannot see.
Hands quiet. We hold the lane. Through traffic keeps right except to pass. We are through traffic.
Count the gap. If you cannot count it, it is not a hole.
I am going to take this one late. Watch what that costs.
Blinker. No hole yet. I take it anyway.
Horn behind. That's on me. I made a man lift.
He had to stand on it. I spent his margin so I could keep mine.
Schedule's still the schedule. I just wrote a late on it.
That's the merge you do not take. You saw the consequence. I do not get a free one.
Thermos. Two clean stops reset me. This was not one.
Your eyes now. Left glass. Right glass. The side mirror. Then the road.

called.ride_open: Keep your voice down in this cab. After that lot, I would too. Left mirror. Right mirror. Left again.

correct.ride_open: You did the quiet cut. The lot took her anyway. That is not on this merge. Left mirror. Right mirror. Left again.

slow.ride_open: You spent the time. The lot does not give it back. Keep your eyes moving. Left mirror. Right mirror. Left again.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part one
source.teaching_target: Demonstrate-first: sweep, hold right, never take a late merge; consequence is a horn and a man who had to lift.
